The **Austin Public Library** is the public library serving **Austin, Minnesota**, a city in **Mower County**. Here’s everything I could find about it:

---

### **1. Basic Information**
- **Name:** Austin Public Library
- **Location:**
  - **Address:** 323 4th Ave NE, Austin, MN 55912
  - **Phone:** (507) 433-0960
  - **Website:** [https://www.austinpubliclibrary.org/](https://www.austinpubliclibrary.org/)
- **Hours (as of recent updates):**
  - **Monday–Thursday:** 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
  - **Friday–Saturday:** 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  - **Sunday:** 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM
  *(Hours may vary; check the website for updates.)*
- **Library System:** Part of the **Southeastern Libraries Cooperating (SELCO)** regional library system, which provides shared resources, interlibrary loans, and digital services to libraries in southeastern Minnesota.

---

### **2. History**
- The **Austin Public Library** was established in **1903** after a donation from **Andrew Carnegie**, who funded over 2,500 libraries worldwide. The original Carnegie library building was constructed in **1904** and served the community for decades.
- The current **modern library building** opened in **1996** at its current location (323 4th Ave NE), replacing the older Carnegie structure.
- The library has undergone renovations and expansions over the years to accommodate growing collections and technology needs.

---

### **3. Services & Resources**
#### **Collections**
- **Books:** Fiction, non-fiction, large print, audiobooks, and e-books (via **Libby/OverDrive** and **Hoopla**).
- **Children’s Section:** Picture books, early readers, juvenile fiction, and educational materials.
- **Teen Section:** Young adult books, graphic novels, and study resources.
- **Local History & Genealogy:**
  - The library houses the **Mower County Historical Society’s research materials**, including local newspapers, city directories, and genealogical records.
  - Access to **Ancestry Library Edition** (in-library use only).
- **Periodicals:** Magazines, newspapers (including the **Austin Daily Herald**).
- **DVDs & Blu-rays:** Movies, TV shows, and documentaries.
- **Music CDs & Audiobooks.**
- **Language Learning:** Resources like **Mango Languages** (available online).

#### **Digital Services**
- **eBooks & eAudiobooks:** Available through **Libby (OverDrive)** and **Hoopla**.
- **Digital Magazines:** **Libby (OverDrive)** and **Flipster**.
- **Online Databases:** Access to **EBSCOhost, Gale Courses, LearningExpress Library, and more** (via SELCO).
- **Streaming Media:** **Kanopy** (movies & documentaries) and **Hoopla** (music, comics, TV shows).
- **Computer & Internet Access:**
  - Public computers with internet, printing, and scanning.
  - Free **Wi-Fi** for library visitors.
  - **Tech Help:** Staff assistance with basic computer and device questions.

#### **Programs & Events**
The library offers a variety of **free programs** for all ages, including:
- **Children’s Programs:**
  - Storytimes (babies, toddlers, preschoolers).
  - Summer Reading Program (part of the **Collaborative Summer Library Program**).
  - LEGO clubs, craft sessions, and educational activities.
- **Teen Programs:**
  - Book clubs, gaming events, and college prep workshops.
- **Adult Programs:**
  - Book clubs (fiction, non-fiction, mystery).
  - Author visits, writing workshops, and local history talks.
  - Technology classes (e.g., basic computer skills, e-reader help).
  - **Adult Summer Reading Program.**
- **Special Events:**
  - Seasonal events (e.g., holiday crafts, tax help sessions).
  - Community partnerships (e.g., with the **Austin ArtWorks Center** or **Hormel Historic Home**).

#### **Meeting Rooms & Study Spaces**
- **Meeting Rooms:** Available for public use (reservations may be required).
- **Quiet Study Areas:** Individual and group study spaces.
- **Teen & Children’s Activity Areas.**

#### **Other Services**
- **Interlibrary Loan (ILL):** Access to books and materials from other libraries in Minnesota and beyond.
- **Notary Services:** Available by appointment (may have a small fee).
- **Fax & Printing:** Black-and-white and color printing (fees apply).
- **Homebound Services:** Delivery of materials to homebound residents.
- **Passport Services:** The library serves as a **Passport Acceptance Facility** (appointment required).

---

### **4. Community Role & Partnerships**
- **Mower County Historical Society:** The library collaborates with the historical society to preserve and provide access to local history resources.
- **Austin Public Schools:** Partners with schools for literacy programs and student resources.
- **Hormel Historic Home:** Occasionally hosts joint events.
- **SELCO (Southeastern Libraries Cooperating):** Provides shared resources, courier services, and professional development for library staff.
- **Minnesota Digital Library:** Contributes to digital archives of Minnesota history.

---

### **5. Building & Facilities**
- **Size:** Approximately **20,000 square feet**.
- **Architecture:** Modern design with large windows, open spaces, and dedicated areas for different age groups.
- **Accessibility:** Wheelchair-accessible, ADA-compliant restrooms, and assistive technologies.
- **Art & Displays:** Features local artwork and rotating exhibits.

---

### **6. Funding & Governance**
- **Funding:** Supported by **city taxes**, **state aid**, and **grants** (including from the **Minnesota Department of Education**).
- **Governance:** Operated by the **City of Austin** and overseen by a **Library Board of Trustees**.
- **Friends of the Austin Public Library:** A volunteer group that supports the library through fundraising, book sales, and advocacy.

---

### **7. Unique Features**
- **Local History Collection:** One of the best in the region for researching Mower County and Austin history.
- **Carnegie Legacy:** Though the original Carnegie building is no longer in use, the library honors its history.
- **Community Hub:** A gathering place for book clubs, study groups, and cultural events.

---

### **8. How to Get a Library Card**
- **Residents of Austin & Mower County:** Free library card with proof of address.
- **Non-Residents:** Can obtain a card for a small annual fee.
- **Online Registration:** Available via the [SELCO website](https://www.selco.info/).
- **Digital-Only Cards:** Available for e-resources.

---

### **9. Contact & Social Media**
- **Email:** [austinpl@selco.info](mailto:austinpl@selco.info)
- **Facebook:** [Austin Public Library MN](https://www.facebook.com/AustinPublicLibraryMN/)
- **Instagram:** [@austinpubliclibrary](https://www.instagram.com/austinpubliclibrary/)

---

### **10. Nearby Libraries**
If you're in the area, other nearby SELCO libraries include:
- **Albert Lea Public Library** (~25 miles away)
- **Owatonna Public Library** (~40 miles away)
- **Rochester Public Library** (~45 miles away)

---

### **11. Fun Facts**
- The original **Carnegie library building** (1904–1996) was located at **201 4th Ave NE** and is now a private residence.
- The library has hosted **famous authors**, including **Garrison Keillor** (a Minnesota native).
- It was one of the first libraries in Minnesota to offer **public internet access** in the 1990s.

---

### **12. Recent News & Updates**
- The library has expanded its **digital offerings** in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
- Recent **renovations** have improved study spaces and children’s areas.
- The **Friends of the Library** hold **quarterly book sales** (a great way to find deals on used books).

---

### **Final Thoughts**
The **Austin Public Library** is a **vibrant community resource** offering far more than just books. Whether you're a **reader, researcher, student, or tech user**, it provides valuable services, programs, and a welcoming space for all ages.
